name: Fervent Mania
source:
"Fervent Mania" adopts the format of a dating sim, albeit with a deeply unsettling and dark undertone, where your goal is to endure a series of situations  with Spencer Volkov. The content of this game delves into disturbing themes, including rape, torture, death, and other twisted elements, which distinctly set it apart from conventional dating sims.

[From [url=https://vlxck.itch.io/fervent-mania-play-test]Itch.io[/url]]
